item.title: AI Engineer London - October 26
item.description:
Last week I got back to the AI Engineer London meetup for the first time in a while. It was great to see Eddie Forson again and to meet Tiago Pina, Amandine Flachs and Nel Bandularatne. I always enjoy going to London AI meetups, but it’s been over a month since I’ve gone to one because I’ve had so many travels and some game projects I had to attend to.

I wanted to share a couple of interesting things from the talks.
